paper.title_en: Cosmology & Astrophysics of the Dark Dimension with Bulk Majorana Neutrinos
paper.abstract_en: Recently, the possibility of having sterile Majorana neutrinos charged under $B-L$ gauge symmetry in the bulk of the dark dimension has been explored. We point out a cosmological restriction on the Majorana mass of bulk neutrinos leading to mass $\gtrsim 100~{\rm GeV}$. This avoids the over-production of Kaluza-Klein neutrino towers in the early universe thus resolving the cosmological neutrino catastrophe of extra dimension scenarios. If the mass of the bulk neutrino is at the lower end of this bound, it can potentially also explain the recently observed Fermi halo excess on gamma rays through the evaporation of long-lived 5d (i.e. dark) black holes through Hawking radiation to bulk neutrinos, which promptly decay into standard model particles.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文探讨了额外维（暗维度）中体Majorana中微子的宇宙学与天体物理效应，给出了Majorana质量大于约100 GeV的宇宙学限制，以避免早期宇宙中Kaluza-Klein中微子塔的过度产生，并关联到5维（暗）黑洞通过Hawking辐射蒸发产生体中微子进而解释Fermi晕伽马射线过量。该工作涉及黑洞热力学（Hawking辐射）、额外维宇宙学与粒子物理交叉，理论深度较高、叙述清晰，虽无同行评议记录且无引用，但作为新论文其新颖性信号合理，值得研究者进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 带有体Majorana中微子的暗维度宇宙学与天体物理学
decision.abstract_zh: 最近，有人探索了在暗维度的体（bulk）中具有在$B-L$规范对称性下带电的无菌Majorana中微子的可能性。我们指出，对体中微子的Majorana质量存在一个宇宙学限制，导致质量$\gtrsim 100~{\rm GeV}$。这避免了早期宇宙中Kaluza-Klein中微子塔的过度产生，从而解决了额外维度情景中的宇宙学中微子灾难。如果体中微子的质量处于该限制的下限，它还可能通过长寿命5维（即暗）黑洞通过Hawking辐射蒸发成体中微子、而这些体中微子又迅速衰变为标准模型粒子，来解释最近观测到的费米晕伽马射线过量。
